description: Normalize a seller's earnings into seller's discretionary earnings (SDE), itemizing each add-back with a conservative case alongside, then bridge to cash flow available for debt service and apply a multiple range the user supplies. Returns claimed SDE, conservative SDE, excluded double-counted adjustments, cash flow for debt service and the value range. Use when the user asks what the earnings are or what the business is worth on them. The tool does not supply industry multiples.

amount.description: The adjustment amount. In US dollars.

includeInConservative.description: False for an add-back a lender would likely refuse.

label.description: A short label, such as "Owner salary".

baseEarnings.description: The base earnings figure, in US dollars. May be negative.

basis.description: What the base earnings figure is. Add-backs already inside the basis are refused.

cashTaxes.description: Cash taxes the buyer will pay. Bridge deduction. In US dollars.

highMultiple.description: High SDE multiple the user supplies, such as 3.5.

lowMultiple.description: Low SDE multiple the user supplies, such as 2.5.

maintenanceCapex.description: Annual maintenance capital spending. Bridge deduction. In US dollars.

replacementManagement.description: Market cost of a manager to replace the owner. Bridge deduction. In US dollars.

workingCapitalIncrease.description: Annual working capital the business absorbs. Bridge deduction. In US dollars.

name: normalize_sde_valuation
title: Normalize SDE and value the business
